## Quality Gates (MUST pass)

- [ ] CHK001 `pnpm type-check` — 0 TypeScript errors
- [ ] CHK002 `pnpm lint` — 0 errors (warnings tolerated)
- [ ] CHK003 `pnpm test` — all tests pass
- [ ] CHK004 `cd backend && pnpm build` — strict TypeScript, 0 errors
